label: Roots of Every Polynomial
subgoals: An algebraic closure contains a root of every nonconstant polynomial over the base field.
It is algebraically closed and contains no proper algebraically closed subfield over the base.

label: Existence and Uniqueness
subgoals: Every field has an algebraic closure, and any two are isomorphic over the base field.
The proof uses Zorn's lemma to assemble a maximal algebraic extension.

label: Finite Subfields
subgoals: The algebraic closure of a finite field is infinite.
Its finite subfields correspond to degrees that divide one another.
